message: さすらいのさすりあい

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just the two of us... in the dark... could this be my chance?」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like you've been talking to yourself a lot lately」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's just your imagination, your imagination. Ahaha」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! The test is super bad! Ahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「I knew it... Still, we can't take the night off from patrol」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But... if I don't do it now... when will I」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess they don't show up every single day either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still... I couldn't even manage his stomach, so his chest is...」

name: Synn
message: 「You've been acting weird for a while now」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... you have a stomachache or something?」
All of a sudden, Nanaka clutched her stomach and crouched down.

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Actually... my stomach's been hurting for a while now...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh, it hurts, it hurts, it hurts... guhhhhh」
No, wait, it's just Nanaka, and she's my childhood friend.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It hurts. It's kinda throbbing. Appendicitis and twisted intestines doing a giant spin straight downhill. Ugh, guh」
She's in so much pain that her words are becoming incoherent!!
Doing nothing when she's suffering this much would be wrong as her childhood friend.
For some reason, I swallowed hard with a gulp.
I-It's no big deal, I'm just rubbing Nanaka's stomach.
Calm down, me. Whoa, she's warm... A girl's body heat.
Ah, her hair smells nice. Must be shampoo.
Plus, it's so pretty and glossy.
And she's way more slender than I thought... yet it feels this good...
No, no! That's not what this is about!
Agh, agh! I was supposed to be helping Nanaka feel better, what kind of indecent thoughts am I having!

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-My chest hurts too... This might be, ugh, that chronic chest spasm thing you always see in period dramas...」
Calm down, me. Nanaka never said anything about rubbing her chest.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I-If you rubbed it for me, maybe the pain would go away」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, so I just need to rub your chest...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, hold on!! Rubbing your chest is way too much, no matter how you look at it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I wonder if I'm gonna die... b-because nobody would rub my chest...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「P-Please, Synn... you're the only one I can ask to do something like this...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Just what do you think you're doing?」
A voice so cold it sent a chill down my spine.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Is the Student Council using pointless patrols as an excuse to engage in improper relations with the opposite sex, I wonder?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's right! I started feeling sick, so I had him rub my--」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「What an unnatural excuse. Besides, you don't look sick to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But she really looked like she was in pain just a second ago! Nanaka isn't the kind of person who would lie to me!」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Or are the two of you close enough that you can be that certain?」
Ms. Sengen'in looked us up and down as if sizing us up. It gave me an unpleasant feeling.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn didn't do anything wrong! I was the one who--」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Both of you, go home right away. Especially you, Synn Sakura. This is your second warning.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「If I catch you acting suspiciously again, I'll have no choice but to speak with the head of student guidance.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「It's exam period right now. You should leave security to the security guards.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ms. Sengen'in! This is something only the Student Council can do... So...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「You're a scholarship student, aren't you? I look forward to seeing your grades.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「And Ms. Yuugiri. Your grades haven't been looking too great either, have they?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... But what about you, Sensei? Why are you out at this hour?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I'm patrolling precisely because there are students like you two.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Understood. We'll head back in just a little while.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Isn't it how your stomachache suddenly vanished out of nowhere?」

name: Synn
message: 「So it stopped hurting. That's a relief. Still, let's call it a night here.」
I was just moments away from intentionally groping Nanaka's breasts.
Even though I didn't really mean to do that, even though I knew it was wrong...

name: Paqy
message: 「Then what are you saying is weird?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No. Ms. Sengen'in said she was on patrol, but... I haven't heard anything about that from Chairwoman Helena.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So she's doing it on her own?」
Could she be connected to the Demons appearing at night... No, I shouldn't jump to conclusions.

name: Synn
message: 「That said, I don't have any proof. Come on, let's go home.」
